mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances when the CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past two months indicates a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances when HOUST drops by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% annually, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy coupled with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 4% and GDPC1 annual growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past three months indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances when RSAFS shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the past month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances when UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy, which is a positive signal for equity markets and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.5 percentage points.
